analysis_steps.goal: Constrain column density and excitation temperature via LTE grid fitting

method.value: Generate LTE synthetic spectra over two grids (coarse then fine) of column density N and excitation temperature T_ex, and compute chi-square on unblended and selected undetected lines; also derive upper limits for isomers and 1,3-propanediol

findings_qualitative.value: Tentative first detection of 3-hydroxypropenal (HOCHCHCHO) in the interstellar medium towards IRAS 16293-2422 B

evidence.quote: we tentatively detected 3-hydroxypropenal (HOCHCHCHO) for the first time in the interstellar medium towards source B.

findings_qualitative.value: HOCHCHCHO is mainly formed via the grain surface reaction CH2CHO + HCO -> HCOCH2CHO followed by tautomerization into HOCHCHCHO

evidence.quote: This species is mainly formed through the grain surface reaction CH$_2$CHO + HCO $\rightarrow$ HCOCH$_2$CHO, followed by the tautomerization of HCOCH$_2$CHO into HOCHCHCHO.

findings_qualitative.value: Two isomers, CH3COCHO (methyl glyoxal) and CH2COHCHO (2-hydroxypropenal), are predicted to be more abundant than HOCHCHCHO

evidence.quote: Two isomers, CH$_3$COCHO and CH$_2$COHCHO, are predicted to be even more abundant than HOCHCHCHO.

claims.hypothesis: 3-hydroxypropenal (HOCHCHCHO) is present and detectable in the solar-type protostar IRAS 16293-2422 B
claims.experiment: Applied a CNN to the ALMA-PILS spectrum of IRAS 16293 B and performed a classical LTE synthetic spectrum and chi-square analysis with CASSIS across Band 7 and Band 6
claims.result: 11 lines in Band 7 (7 fully reproduced, 4 partially blended) and 2 faint lines in Band 6 match HOCHCHCHO, yielding N ~ 1.0 x 10^15 cm^-2 (at T_ex = 125 K) and an abundance of 10^-4 relative to CH3OH
claims.finding: 3-hydroxypropenal is tentatively detected for the first time in the interstellar medium towards IRAS 16293 B

evidence.quote: we tentatively detected 3-hydroxypropenal (HOCHCHCHO) for the first time in the interstellar medium towards source B.
Seven lines are correctly reproduced by the model and can be identified as HOCHCHCHO. The lines at 333.1546, 341.8653, 356.3017, and 362.2382 GHz are only partially reproduced
In Band 6, two faint lines are detected at 247.5312 and 250.4599 GHz and are in agreement with the model.

claims.hypothesis: Grain-surface radical association reactions and keto-enol tautomerization can account for the observed abundance of HOCHCHCHO in IRAS 16293 B
claims.experiment: Updated the Nautilus three-phase chemical network with six C3H4O2 isomers and DFT-calculated reaction barriers, and simulated the pre-stellar and protostellar collapse phases
claims.result: The model predicts an HOCHCHCHO abundance relative to CH3OH of 4.6 x 10^-4 (within a factor of 10 uncertainty), consistent with the observed 1.0 x 10^-4, mainly via CH2CHO + HCO -> HCOCH2CHO followed by tautomerization
claims.finding: The chemical model reproduces the observed abundance of HOCHCHCHO within uncertainties through grain-surface radical association and tautomerization

evidence.quote: The model reproduces the abundance of HOCHCHCHO within the uncertainties. This species is mainly formed through the grain surface reaction CH$_2$CHO + HCO $\rightarrow$ HCOCH$_2$CHO, followed by the tautomerization of HCOCH$_2$CHO into HOCHCHCHO.
HOCHCHCHO has a predicted abundance with respect to CH$_3$OH of 4.6\,$\times$\,10$^{-4}$ in agreement with the observations (1\,$\times$\,10$^{-4}$)

claims.hypothesis: Other C3H4O2 isomers are also abundant and potentially detectable in IRAS 16293 B
claims.experiment: Predicted abundances of five other C3H4O2 isomers with the Nautilus code and searched for spectroscopically available isomers (C2H3OCHO and C2H3COOH) in PILS data
claims.result: C2H3OCHO and C2H3COOH are not detected (upper limits <= 4 x 10^-4 and <= 5 x 10^-4 relative to CH3OH, consistent with low predicted abundances of 2.8 x 10^-5 and 7.3 x 10^-9), whereas CH3COCHO and CH2COHCHO are predicted at 2.4 x 10^-3 and 6.6 x 10^-4 relative to CH3OH but lack spectroscopic catalog data
claims.finding: CH3COCHO and CH2COHCHO are predicted to be more abundant than HOCHCHCHO and potentially detectable once spectroscopic studies become available

evidence.quote: Two isomers, CH$_3$COCHO and CH$_2$COHCHO, are predicted to be even more abundant than HOCHCHCHO. Spectroscopic studies of these molecules are essential in searching for them in IRAS 16293–2422 and other astrophysical sources.
In addition, CH$_3$COCHO and CH$_2$COHCHO also show high abundances (with respect to CH$_3$OH) of 2\,$\times$\,10$^{-3}$ and 6\,$\times$\,10$^{-4}$, respectively.

why_this_data.value: The ALMA-PILS survey is an unbiased spectral survey of IRAS 16293-2422, ideal for identifying complex organic molecules, and the 0.5 arcsec offset position towards component B exhibits narrow (FWHM ~ 1 km s^-1), bright lines free of strong absorption

evidence.quote: The Protostellar Interferometric Line Survey (PILS, (cite: Jorgensen2016)), carried out with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA), has contributed significantly to the characterization of the chemical content in this source.

This position is regularly used in the PILS studies to search for molecules and isotopologues, as the lines are relatively narrow ($FWHM$ $\sim$ 1 km s$^{-1}$) and bright without being affected by absorption features (cite: Coutens2016; Lykke2017).

why_this_method.value: A CNN was used to rapidly screen the multi-species spectrum for candidate molecules, followed by standard CASSIS LTE synthetic spectrum fitting on unblended lines and Nautilus three-phase chemical modeling to understand formation pathways

evidence.quote: Using a dedicated convolutional neural network (CNN) on a large set of multi-species synthetic spectra assuming local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE, (cite: Boulanger2022)), we predicted the presence of HOCHCHCHO in the PILS data with a probability greater than 50%.
To better understand the chemistry of HOCHCHCHO and its isomers, we used the Nautilus code (cite: Ruaud2016), a three-phase gas, grain surface, and grain mantle time-dependent chemical model.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Searching for HOCHCHCHO towards IRAS 16293 A was rejected because broader lines prevent identification of isolated transitions

evidence.quote: As the lines are broader towards IRAS16293 A, it is not possible to identify isolated transitions of 3-hydroxypropenal toward that source.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: High excitation temperature (>= 300 K) for HOCHCHCHO was disfavored because transitions at 343.4656, 349.9189, and 350.0168 GHz are not detected within their spectroscopic uncertainties

evidence.quote: However, there are a few exceptions for the transitions at 343.4656, 349.9189, and 350.0168 GHz that do not show lines within their uncertainties, which suggests that the excitation temperature could be lower than 300 K.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Formation of C3H4O2 isomers via O or OH reactions with unsaturated C3HxO species on grains was found to be inefficient compared to HCO + C2H3O radical associations

evidence.loc: Chemical modeling of 3-hydroxypropenal (HOCHCHCHO) and its isomers
evidence.quote: However, O mainly reacts with the abundant radicals on the grains (HCO, CH$_2$OH, and CH$_3$O) and the production of C$_3$H$_4$O$_2$ isomers from the reactions of O is limited.

evidence.loc: Chemical modeling of 3-hydroxypropenal (HOCHCHCHO) and its isomers
evidence.quote: In contrast to the O + C$_3$H$_x$O reactions, the reactions with HCO are much more efficient because HCO is abundant and relatively mobile on the grains (cite: Wakelam2017; Minissale2016).

limitations_admitted.value: Excitation temperature of HOCHCHCHO is poorly constrained (75-350 K) because detected unblended lines span a small range of E_up and high-J, low-K_a transitions have large spectroscopic uncertainties

evidence.quote: However, the excitation temperature was not well constrained. Our $\chi^2$ analysis shows that various models with excitation temperatures in the 75–350 K range can properly reproduce the lines included in the calculation (3$\sigma$ uncertainty).
It is due to the $E_{\rm up}$ values of the detected lines that only span a small range

limitations_admitted.value: Four of the 11 detected Band 7 lines are only partially reproduced by the best-fit model, likely due to partial blending with unknown species

evidence.quote: The lines at 333.1546, 341.8653, 356.3017, and 362.2382 GHz are only partially reproduced, which could mean that they are partially blended with unknown species.

limitations_admitted.value: Three C3H4O2 isomers (HCOCH2CHO, CH3COCHO, CH2COHCHO) lack spectroscopic entries in CDMS and JPL and could not be searched for in the data

evidence.quote: HCOCH$_2$CHO (propanedial), CH$_3$COCHO (methylglyoxal), and CH$_2$COHCHO (2-hydroxypropenal) are not in the spectroscopic databases CDMS and JPL (cite: Pickett1998).

limitations_admitted.value: Predicted chemical abundances have a total uncertainty of about a factor of 10 due to uncertain branching ratios (factor of 2) and H-atom destruction tunneling barriers (factor of 5), and grain isomerization of CH3COCHO into CH2COHCHO may be less favorable than modeled

evidence.quote: For CH$_2$COHCHO, it is more ambiguous because one of the main pathways of formation is the isomerization of CH$_3$COCHO, which could be very less favorable on grains that the result given by the methodology used here.
Thus, the total uncertainty on the predicted abundances of the C$_3$H$_4$O$_2$ isomers is about a factor of 10.

referee_caveats_inferred: The detection is only tentative, relying on 7 unblended lines in a highly line-rich spectrum where confusion and partial blending (seen in 4 additional lines) are pervasive.

The source size (beam filling factor) assumed in the CASSIS LTE modeling and the exact reference CH3OH column density are not explicitly stated in this Letter, requiring consultation of earlier PILS papers.

reproducibility.score_reason: The PILS dataset is public, the extraction coordinates, line lists, spectroscopic parameters (CDMS), LTE grid parameters, and new chemical reactions are thoroughly tabulated, though a few inherited parameters (source size, CH3OH reference column density, full Nautilus network file) require consulting companion papers.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA-PILS archival data with exact extraction coordinates, complete line tables, and clear numeric column density targets reproducible via standard LTE spectral fitting (CASSIS).

methods_papers.why: Convolutional neural network (CNN) method used to predict the presence of HOCHCHCHO in the PILS spectrum
CASSIS spectral analysis software used for LTE modeling and line identification

companion_papers.why: ALMA-PILS survey overview, observations, data reduction, and continuum subtraction
Baseline list of previously identified species in IRAS 16293 B used for spectral overlay
Three-carbon molecule study in IRAS 16293 B providing the base chemical network, initial abundances, and two-stage physical collapse model

fixed.old: The barriers and imaginary frequencies are calculated at M06-2X/AVTZ level
fixed.new: The barriers were calculated using the DFT method associated with the M06-2X functional.
